basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software developer living in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. I'm passionate about technology and game development, which is why you'll often find me browsing through Unity tutorials. In my free time, I enjoy listening to alternative and indie music, frequently checking out subreddits like Hopefulcasesmusic. I'm not a smoker, but I'm intrigued by discussions on the socio-political aspects of drug legalization. I work remotely for a tech startup and enjoy the flexibility it provides. I'm single and spend most evenings online, usually between 7 PM to midnight local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the Technical University of Cluj-Napoca, I've spent the past decade honing my skills in software development and game design. I'm mostly self-taught in Unity through online resources and community forums.
